subject_notes: Trapped-ion quantum computing. AFRL Rome (FA8750) contracting history including named AFRL Quantum Networking program. Recent acquisitions: Capella Space, Oxford Ionics, ID Quantique, Qubitekk, Lightsynq, Vector Atomic.
extraction_notes: 10-K narrative is thin on specifically named DoD programs/PE numbers — IonQ names AFRL (Air Force Research Lab) as a partner/customer and DARPA as a co-development partner but does not disclose contract value, PE number, or % revenue attribution per program. This thinness is itself the disclosure pattern; we test it against the J-Book corpus. Q2 2024 10-Q confirms two significant customers = 79%/75% (Q2 / H1 2024) revenue concentration.
